NAME: Participant table
DESCRIPTION: The Participant table stores records for individuals in recovery from substance use disorder who are seeking or receiving workforce development support. It captures demographic information, recovery status, service engagement, employment readiness, and participation in program activities. This table serves as the central entity for tracking participant progress, outcomes, and interactions across workforce, clinical, and support services.

NAME: Enrollment table
DESCRIPTION: The Enrollment table captures information collected when an individual enrolls to receive services through TSRG. It includes intake details such as enrollment date, referral source, eligibility criteria, consent status, initial assessments, and program selection. This table establishes the participants formal entry into services and serves as the foundation for linking participants to specific programs, services, and subsequent activities.

NAME: Assessment table
DESCRIPTION: The Assessment table stores structured data from tools and evaluations used to understand a participants needs, strengths, and readiness for workforce engagement. It includes assessment type, date administered, domains measured such as recovery capital, employment readiness, barriers to employment, and education or skill levels, as well as scores and key findings. This table supports individualized service planning, progress tracking over time, and outcome evaluation by linking assessment results to participant goals, training pathways, and program participation.

NAME: Services table
DESCRIPTION: The Services table captures all workforce development, recovery support, and related services provided to participants through TSRG and its partners. It includes service type, date and duration, provider, delivery method, and associated program or funding source. This table tracks participant engagement in services such as case management, job readiness training, supported employment, and recovery supports, enabling monitoring of service utilization, coordination across providers, and evaluation of outcomes.

NAME: Training table
DESCRIPTION: The Training table captures information related to education and skill building activities completed or in progress for participants. It includes training type, provider, start and end dates, modality, credential or certification pursued, and completion status. This table tracks participant participation in workforce aligned training such as vocational programs, certifications, and soft skills development, supporting monitoring of skill attainment, career pathway progression, and alignment with employment outcomes.

NAME: Employment outcomes table
DESCRIPTION: The Employment Outcomes table captures participant employment status and job-related outcomes over time. It includes data such as employment start and end dates, employer, job title, wages, hours worked, benefits, and job retention milestones. This table tracks placement into employment, job stability, and career progression, supporting evaluation of workforce program effectiveness and long term economic mobility for participants in recovery.

NAME: Follow-up table
DESCRIPTION: The Follow Up table captures ongoing check ins with participants after enrollment or service engagement to monitor progress, stability, and outcomes over time. It includes follow up date, method of contact, participant status, updates on recovery, employment, and training, as well as any identified needs or referrals. This table supports longitudinal tracking, ensures continuity of care, and provides data on retention, outcomes, and long term impact of services.

NAME: Employer table
DESCRIPTION: The Employer table stores information on organizations that hire, engage, or partner with TSRG to support workforce development for participants in recovery. It includes employer name, industry, location, contact information, recovery friendly or fair chance hiring status, and partnership details. Employers may include recovery friendly employers (RFE) as well as other employers who are not formally designated but are willing to engage in hiring or supporting participants. This table supports tracking of employment placements, employer engagement, job opportunities, and the development of strategic relationships aligned with participant career pathways.

NAME: Staff table
DESCRIPTION: The Staffing table stores information on TSRG staff and affiliated personnel involved in delivering services and supporting program operations. It includes staff name, role, credentials, organizational affiliation, contact information, and assigned responsibilities such as case management, training, employer engagement, or program oversight. It may also capture the treatment center or provider associated with the participant or staff member, enabling coordination between workforce services and clinical care. This table supports tracking of staff involvement across participants, services, and programs, as well as alignment with treatment partners, to support coordination, accountability, and workforce capacity planning.

NAME: Exit and Discharge
DESCRIPTION: Exit and discharge variables capture the circumstances and outcomes associated with a participant leaving a TSRG program or service. These fields include exit date, discharge type (planned or unplanned), reason for exit (such as employment obtained, transition to another program, disengagement, or loss of contact), and participant status at exit, including employment, training, and recovery stability. Additional variables may document referrals at discharge, follow up plans, and completion of program goals. These data support evaluation of program effectiveness, participant outcomes, retention, and continuity of care.
